headline: 123's Continental Drift
deck: Europe circles 123's Haaland and Schade; Foden draws interest, hitting test4
body:
The gossip pages do 123 no favours this morning. Haaland and Schade both sit on his roster, and both feature in the same wave of interest from Europe's top clubs. Liverpool are named as suitors for Schade; Haaland is folded into the wider run on City's forwards. Nothing is signed, nothing is dated, and neither man is going anywhere this window on the strength of a Thursday column.

test4 has his own reason to read on. Foden is named among the City players drawing looks from the continent. As with the rest, it is interest and nothing firmer, no fee, no timeline, no departure. The assets stay where they are for now, but two of the league's cornerstones have Europe's eyes on them.
